description: Three CI flakes seen on 2026-11-04, each fixed at its cause. (1) The watcher's Headless-Wait reports a proxy refusal as 'not running after the start' when the game wrote its refused status and exited before the watcher first looked (PR 62 harness-windows, run 41852870156): read the status file before giving up. (2) test_pc_deploy's restore-wait test deletes _active.json from a timer at exactly the 1 s poll, and on Windows the delete fails while the reader holds the file (main gates windows-latest, run 41857256437). (3) test_capture's stress check 'a recording starts only with a waiter' reads `waiting` after the render thread's CAS, so a ctl timeout in between counts a false error (W20 run 41844358937, seeds 3 and 4). Liam, 2026-11-04: fix now.
title: Three CI flakes: the watcher's refused-launch race, the restore-wait test, the capture stress check
